R161.note: Per-category method allowlist restricts dynamic dispatch to the one legitimate method (send) that actually exists on the handler, closing the vector without narrowing legitimate use.

R162.note: th:utext to th:text is the canonical Thymeleaf escaping fix; preserves the preview contract and only changes escaping as intended.

R165.note: Inserts -- right after the archive path exactly as the stated contract requires, so every filename, including ones starting with -, is archived as a literal.

R166.note: Drops shell=True for an argument list; Windows CreateProcess special-cases .bat/.cmd so this still launches the script, and return value/exception behavior is unchanged.
